description: Batch 6 large-number width and spacing, prefixed ordinal, approximate marker, and emergency/counter precedence contract. All audited rows promote current span output without a runtime transition.

stable_decisions.owner_contract: ordinary numeric reading supports large groups through 경; a 21-digit 해-width value is unsupported and the no-Hangul input preserves exactly

stable_decisions.owner_contract: prefixed ordinal owns 제5차 and generates canonical spacing after 제 while the independent number before 여 retains its attached approximate marker
large_unit_atomic fully consumes the compact mixed core and preserves the immediately attached approximate 여

stable_decisions.input: 제62회 무역의 날 기념식에선 SK하이닉스가 참여했습니다.

stable_decisions.owner_contract: prefixed ordinal and acronym fallback claims remain independent and render their canonical readings

stable_decisions.input: 긴급번호 112는 경찰 신고 번호이고 112명은 회의실에 있다
